display-lugdi.purpose: The Lugdi cover title only, printed on the painting with a red then black misregistered layer and worn by the ink mask. Devanagari line height 1.3, mask dropped.

display-station.purpose: The station name on the enamel name board only. Devanagari 1.3.

score.purpose: The one score per result, in the roundel or on flap tiles. Tabular. Devanagari 1.4.

headline.purpose: The question (the step's H1) and numbers players compare. Devanagari 1.6.

title.purpose: Names, button, chip and slot labels, plates, toasts. Devanagari 1.7.

body.purpose: Only the lines people say: quotes, voice balloons, the cover line, letters. The only use of weight 500. Devanagari 1.7.

label.purpose: Stat keys, units, tab labels, mastheads, meta lines, the credit. Hind 700 at 14. Devanagari 1.65.

shadows.name: enamel-lip
shadows.purpose: Station live main button; pressed shrinks to inset 0 -1px 0.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Sheets rising from the bottom over the scrim.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable part in both worlds. Never yellow.

shadows.purpose: Lugdi caption strips (question box, plates, stat key, byline, day plate, masthead): rules above and below, no side frame.

components.name: Main Button, Live
components.description: The one main button on a puzzle step once a pick is made. Pick yellow, verb-first label naming the consequence. Shown with the Station enamel lip.
components.css: .ds-main-live { width: 320px; min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #FFD23F; color: #17110F; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 100ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-main-live:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-main-live:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; }

components.name: Main Button, Wait
components.description: The main button before the step is ready: same place and size, muted fill, paper outline, a label naming what is missing.
components.css: .ds-main-wait { width: 320px; min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #4A3B57; color: #EFE7D4; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #EFE7D4; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; cursor: default; } .ds-main-wait:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; }

components.name: Main Button, Outside a Puzzle (Lugdi coupon)
components.description: Play, Continue, Share in Lugdi: a newsprint coupon with a triple ink frame. Never yellow. Station uses the white enamel plate raster.
components.css: .ds-main-out { width: 320px; min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #EFE7D4; color: #17110F; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #17110F, inset 0 0 0 4px #EFE7D4, inset 0 0 0 5px #17110F; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-main-out:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); background: #E2D7BE; } .ds-main-out:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; }

components.name: Person Card, Lugdi tile
components.description: Newsprint with a 2.5 px ink frame. Picked prints pick yellow over the stock with multiply, a 3 px frame, an outer paper ring and a tick.
components.css: .ds-ground { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 160px; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #1B0B2E; } .ds-tile { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #EFE7D4; color: #17110F; text-align: left; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px #17110F; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-tile:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); background: #E2D7BE; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #17110F; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; } .ds-tile.is-picked { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #17110F, 0 0 0 3px #EFE7D4; } .ds-tile.is-picked::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #FFD23F; mix-blend-mode: multiply; z-index: -1; } .ds-face { display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #E2D7BE; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(23,17,15,.4); } .ds-stat { font: 700 1.5rem/1.33 Hind, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-quote { font: 500 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; }

components.name: Person Card, Station ticket row
components.description: The Edmondson ticket: cream card with its printed band at the top (a border-image raster in the build, approximated here), a 1 px hairline, 4 px corners. A spent check is a hole cut through the ticket by mask.
components.css: .ds-platform { padding: 16px; background: #181A1B; } .ds-ticket { width: 320px; min-height: 80px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 40px 2px 4px; border: 0; border-top: 14px solid #13308F; border-radius: 4px; background: #E9DFC4; color: #121212; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.55); font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle 9px at calc(100% - 20px) 50%, transparent 97%, #000 100%); mask: radial-gradient(circle 9px at calc(100% - 20px) 50%, transparent 97%, #000 100%); } .ds-ticket:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-ticket:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ticket .ds-face { width: 72px; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #DCD0B0; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: 48 tall, paper fill, 1.5 px ink frame, 4 px corners. Selected is pick yellow with a 3 px frame and an outer paper ring. Never commits a step.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #1B0B2E; } .ds-chip { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #EFE7D4; color: #17110F; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #17110F; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-chip:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); background: #E2D7BE; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #17110F; } .ds-chip[aria-checked="true"] { background: #FFD23F; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #17110F, 0 0 0 3px #EFE7D4; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; }

components.name: Slot
components.description: A job or blank to fill. Empty is the only dashed thing in the system; a valid target turns solid; filled is pick yellow with an ink frame.
components.css: .ds-slots { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 320px; padding: 16px; background: #1B0B2E; } .ds-slot { min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px dashed #EFE7D4; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(18,7,32,.8); color: #FFF3DC; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slot.is-target { border-style: solid; border-width: 3px; padding: 7px 11px; } .ds-slot.is-filled { border: 0; background: #FFD23F; color: #17110F; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #17110F; } .ds-slot:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; }

components.name: Secondary Text Button
components.description: The one secondary action: 48 tall, underlined Title type on a newsprint strip (Lugdi) or a dark veil (Station). Destructive takes a double underline.
components.css: .ds-ground2 { padding: 16px; background: #1B0B2E; } .ds-textbtn { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #EFE7D4; color: #17110F; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-textbtn:active { background: #E2D7BE; } .ds-textbtn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #17110F; }

components.name: Tab Bar, Station
components.description: Navigation: three tabs, Label type, filled icons; the active icon sits in an enamel-white chip. Lugdi marks the active tab with a red icon and underline instead. Never yellow.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { width: 390px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); min-height: 64px; background: #101213; box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 #F4F1E8, inset 0 5px 0 #000; } .ds-tab { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #C9CDD1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 0 6px; font: 700 .875rem/1.43 Hind, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab svg { padding: 3px; box-sizing: content-box; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { color: #F4F1E8; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] svg { background: #F4F1E8; color: #181A1B; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Split-Flap Score
components.description: Station figures on split-flap tiles: two flat halves, enamel-white tabular numerals, the seam drawn behind the numeral, in a dark housing.
components.css: .ds-flaphouse { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 6px; background: #0B0C0D; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #22262A, 0 0 0 1px #000; } .ds-flap { position: relative; isolation: isolate; min-width: 42px; height: 56px; display: grid; place-items: center; font: normal 700 2.25rem/1 Hind, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #F4F1E8; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(#303030 0 50%, #262626 50% 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #000; } .ds-flap::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(50% - 1px); height: 2px; background: #0B0B0B; z-index: -1; }

components.name: Enamel Day Plate
components.description: The Station day plate in the top bar: in the build a cobalt enamel raster (plate-enamel.webp) as a border-image under live enamel-white Title type; approximated here with a white rim on cobalt.
components.css: .ds-platform2 { padding: 16px; background: #181A1B; } .ds-enamel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #13308F; color: #F4F1E8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #13308F, inset 0 0 0 5px #F4F1E8; font: 700 1rem/1.5 Hind, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: One game, drawn by one hand, in two printed worlds
narrative.overview: Each day the puzzle happens on a real printed object: a pulp cover, a reservation chart, an Edmondson ticket, a departure board, a luggage tag. The object changes; the skeleton never does. The same top bar, the question in the same place, the same five tappable looks and the one main button pinned at the bottom, with one meaning for every colour. Lugdi weeks dress the game as the next issue of the "Ghat Series", a 1970s Hindi pulp. A gouache painting fills the phone, the title is printed on it in Sarpanch and worn by an ink mask, and every caption is a newsprint strip with a double ink rule. Station weeks dress it as Indian Railways ephemera: cobalt enamel plates with chipped white rims, cream Edmondson ticket card with its printed band, split-flap tiles. The Station paintings are regraded to a black and ticket-cream duotone so that blue belongs to the enamel alone. The worlds alternate by ISO week and share one skeleton to the pixel.
keyCharacteristics: Two world palettes over one shared pick yellow and one shared focus ring.
Materials are rasters under live type: enamel and ticket plates are CSS border-images, newsprint and ticket grain are tiled textures.
Hind for every word that is read; Sarpanch only on the Lugdi cover title.
Three radii per world, a fixed eight-step spacing scale, and fixed question and dock positions.
Every state is drawn in both worlds, in Hindi, at 200% text and at 360 x 640.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Pick yellow means "you picked this" and its live confirm, nothing else. Never on Play, scores, the "you" row, streak marks, tabs, the board switch, the language chip or the focus ring.

rules.name: The Blue Belongs to Enamel Rule
rules.body: In Station, blue lives only in the enamel and the cobalt marks drawn from it. Paintings are black and ticket-cream duotones; no blue in pictures.

rules.name: The Ink or Paper Rule
rules.body: Running text is ink on paper, or paper, title white or enamel white on a ground or plate. Red and cobalt carry marks and rules, not reading text.

rules.name: The 500 Is Speech Rule
rules.body: Weight 500 appears only in Body, the lines people say. Everything else is 700.

rules.name: The One Cover Title Rule
rules.body: Sarpanch appears once per Lugdi cover, on the title, worn by the ink mask. Station has no display face; its board name is Hind 700.

rules.name: The 14 Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set under 14 px, in either script (measured: no text under 14 px on any phone). At 200% every role scales from its own variable.

rules.name: The Fixed Skeleton Rule
rules.body: Question top at 104 px and dock top at 748 px on every puzzle step; tab screens dock at 682 px. A world changes its dress, never its places.

rules.name: The Printed Not Lit Rule
rules.body: Plates and cards carry no blurred shadow; their edges are ink rules, frames or painted rims. Blur belongs to overlays.

rules.name: The Misregistration Rule
rules.body: Lugdi's red and black offset is a print shift: on the cover title, worn by the ink mask, and under exactly one control, the live main button's 4 px red print edge (R-VIS-22, the OQ-3 default; keeping it is an open owner choice). No other control carries an offset.

dos: Do keep the question top at 104 px and the dock top at 748 px on every puzzle step, and dock tab screens at 682 px.
Do start every card on newsprint (Lugdi) or ticket card (Station), and print a pick by multiplying pick yellow over the stock.
Do put enamel, ticket and newsprint materials under live type as rasters with provenance sidecars, never with baked-in text.
Do set Body (Hind 500) only for lines people say, and everything else in Hind 700.
Do keep blue in Station to the enamel and its cobalt marks, and regrade Station paintings to black and ticket cream.
Do draw every state in both worlds, in Hindi, at 200% text and at 360 x 640.
donts: Don't use yellow for anything but the pick and its live confirm.
Don't add a sixth tappable look; compose new steps from the main button, person card, chip, slot and text button.
Don't use Sarpanch anywhere but the Lugdi cover title.
Don't add a radius beyond 0, 4 and full in either world.
Don't use dashes for anything except an empty slot or blank.
Don't put a hard offset on any control other than the Lugdi live main button's red print edge (R-VIS-22).
Don't set reading text in red or cobalt.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons, or kickers above headings.
